title: Excellent Photoshoot in Barcelona for Solo Travellers!
text: I had an amazing experience during my Instagram Photoshoot with Nati. She was both very professional and super friendly, really it was like being with a friend for two hours who just happens to take lovely photos. I was super happy with the photos, so much so I bought the whole set, it was impossible to pick just 25! The photos came promptly one week later as promised. This experience is perfect for solo travellers, like myself, and the timining of the session in the morning was perfect as it was not too hot or crowded in the city yet. These are the perfect memories for an incredible city!
